api-error.title: API error
api-error.description: The request could not be completed: what went wrong, plus the HTTP status, the path, an ID to find the request in the monitor's log, and when it happened.

statusName.description: The HTTP status's name, in capitals, such as NOT_FOUND.

requestPath.description: The path that was requested, without its query.

requestId.description: The request's ID, as logged by the monitor with reqId.

device-registration.title: Device registration
device-registration.description: A device and how to reach it. Shared by the operations that read or write one.

deviceId.description: Used as a URL path segment, so it can't contain a slash.

baseUrl.description: An http or https URL with no credentials in it.

secretRef.description: The name of the variable holding the token, never the token. Limited to DEVICE_ variables so a device can't be pointed at the service's own secrets.
